tools.name: best_in_category
tools.description: Leading new car or electric car by registration share in Sweden for a month. Includes sources. Not a quality verdict. SEK retail and separate private/business leasing observations are included where verified; USD budget filtering is unavailable.

tools.name: get_ranking
tools.description: Models ranked by rounded share of new registrations within the category and month in Sweden; change is percentage points versus the previous available consecutive month.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find source model groups by brand or model name.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: A model group's registration ranks and share history. Includes current SEK retail and separate private/business lease observations where verified, with sources and contract terms.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare 2–5 model groups by registration share and trend in Sweden. Current SEK pricing appears where verified; no performance or safety verdict.

tools.name: trending
tools.description: Largest changes in registration share versus the previous consecutive month. No invented trend when history is unavailable.

tools.name: meta_build
tools.description: Unavailable: cars are alternatives, not a collection to buy together.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Available Swedish registration categories and data months.
